Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A general knowledge quiz show approached a psychologist and a line cook about being contestants. Both had to take a test beforehand to see if they should be on the show. The psychologist got nearly every answer wrong and was excluded because they wouldn't be a good contestant, but the line cook scored well and was selected. Who is unintelligent?
A. Cannot answer
B. The psychologist
C. The line cook
